data.name: Wachira
data.gender_notes: Wachira is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Kenyan Bantu language, Wachira means 'God's protection'. This name was traditionally given to babies born during times of war or strife, as a reminder of God's watchful care. The name Wachira carries the meaning “God's protection” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Wachira usually hope their child will grow to embody god's protection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carrying God's protection in your heart
data.etymology: Wachira belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's protection.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Wachira total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Achira (Αχίρα) means 'unreprovable, incomparable, inestimable'. This name suggests someone who is beyond reproach and whose worth is beyond calculation.

in_latin.name: Wachira
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Wachira is derived from the Hebrew name וחירה (Wachira), meaning 'choice, selection, preference'. This name reflects the idea of making a thoughtful decision and choosing what is most desirable.

in_english.name: Wachira
in_english.long_meaning: The English name Wachira is derived from the Hebrew name וחירה (Wachira), meaning 'choice, selection, preference'. This name signifies the ability to make thoughtful decisions and choose what is most desirable.
